subject: Short stopgap credits while PO routes to finance
messages:
From: Alex Cho <alex@novalabs.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@novalabs.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Mar 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — keep the pilot live while PO goes through approvals

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at NovaLabs loved the latency profile and the batching suggestions. Finance is routing the PO to the vendor approvals queue this week but they warned it may take 6–8 business days. Our engineers are mid-integration and the trial window will lapse before finance clears.

Is there any way Redwood can provide a small stopgap credit or short-term sandbox voucher to keep the integration running while procurement finishes the PO? We only need the environment for a week or so to finish the E2E tests. If helpful, I can attach the PO acknowledgment — procurement copied here.

Appreciate any flexibility,
Alex
Alex Cho
Head of Product, NovaLabs
attachments: novalabs-po-ack.pdf (application/pdf, stub)

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
To: Alex Cho <alex@novalabs.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, camila_reyes@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 26 Mar 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — keep the pilot live while PO goes through approvals

Alex — thanks for the note and congrats on the fast progress with the integration. I understand the risk of losing momentum while procurement routes the PO.

We can usually cover short runway gaps with a temporary credit allocation, but I need a quick alignment internally on the amount and approvals required. Two quick asks:
- Can you confirm the approximate weekly token spend (or equivalent $ estimate) so we size the stopgap?
- Could procurement reply with the expected approval date or attach the PO acknowledgment? That helps us justify the bridge.

I’ll loop in Karthik and Camila to confirm operational constraints; if we can, I’ll propose a 7-day bridge and a short mutual action plan to keep things moving.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415 555 0123
attachments: none

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, camila_reyes@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 26 Mar 2028 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Quick ask — keep the pilot live while PO goes through approvals

Adding a quick internal note — we have precedent to approve up to $1,200 in bridge credits without finance sign-off for trials under active PO (sales/CS confirmation + PO ack). Anything above that needs a manager OK. Camila, can you confirm current account usage pattern from the sandbox? If they're at <25% runway, a 7-day $1,200 voucher should be safe. Also want to ensure we tag all activity to DL-2037-019 so billing reconciliation is straightforward.

If NovaLabs can confirm expected weekly spend, I can provision via the billing console and attach the bridge-credits-term-stub for signatures.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
To: Alex Cho <alex@novalabs.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@novalabs.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, camila_reyes@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — keep the pilot live while PO goes through approvals

Alex / Procurement Team — thanks for the fast responses. Per Karthik and Camila’s note, we’ve provisioned a 7-day stopgap credit equal to $1,200 (approx. 750k tokens at current plan rates) tied to deal DL-2037-019. Actions and notes below:

- What we did: Applied one-time credit to the NovaLabs sandbox account; token usage will be tracked against DL-2037-019. A bridge-credits-term-stub (attached) documents the limited scope: 7-day runway, single use, and requirement to accept standard billing terms once PO clears.
- Next steps for NovaLabs: Reply-all confirming the approximate weekly usage (or confirm acceptance of the $1,200 amount) and share the PO acknowledgment if possible.
- Procurement ask: Please confirm expected PO clearance date so we can mark the temporary credit for reconciliation.

Attachments: bridge-credits-term-stub.pdf (application/pdf, stub); novalabs-purchase-order-ack.txt (text stub provided by Alex)

Hope this buys you the runway to finish integration. If it looks like finance will take longer than the 7 days, flag us and we can revisit (may need manager approval for an extension).

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
